2608.21157.title: HIERA: Workload-Aware Planning Across Implementation Spaces for GPU Kernel Optimization
2608.21157.paper_summary: High-performance GPU kernels underpin modern deep learning and scientific computing. As workloads become increasingly diverse and GPU hardware evolves rapidly, developing efficient methods for automated GPU kernel generation and optimization has become increasingly important. Existing LLM-based methods typically optimize within a fixed implementation space, limiting either optimization flexibility or search efficiency. We propose \textsc{HIERA}, a hierarchical search-space planning framework for GPU kernel optimization. \textsc{HIERA} constructs contract-augmented task specifications, selects an appropriate implementation space across PyTorch operators, CUDA libraries, and custom CUDA kernels, and uses profiling feedback and expert knowledge to guide structured iterative refinement. Experiments on KernelBench across multiple various workload levels and base LLMs show that \textsc{HIERA} delivers stronger overall implementation validity, sample efficiency, and optimization performance than existing training-free methods, while remaining competitive with the training-based CUDA-L1 without additional model training. A case study on a specialized stencil operator from scientific computing further achieves a \(1.53\times\) speedup over cuDNN, demonstrating the potentiality of the general framework beyond standard machine-learning workloads.
2608.21157.paper_summary_zh: 高效能的 GPU 核心支撐著現代深度學習和科學計算。隨著工作負載變得越來越多樣化，且 GPU 硬體迅速演進，開發自動化 GPU 核心生成和優化的高效方法變得越來越重要。現有的基於 LLM 的方法通常在固定的實現空間內進行優化，限制了優化的靈活性或搜索效率。我們提出了 \textsc{HIERA}，一個用於 GPU 核心優化的分層搜索空間規劃框架。 \textsc{HIERA} 構建了增強合約的任務規範，選擇了跨 PyTorch 操作、CUDA 庫和自定義 CUDA 核心的適當實現空間，並利用分析反饋和專家知識來指導結構化的迭代精煉。在 KernelBench 上針對多種工作負載水平和基礎 LLM 的實驗顯示，\textsc{HIERA} 提供了比現有的無訓練方法更強的整體實現有效性、樣本效率和優化性能，同時在不進行額外模型訓練的情況下，仍然與基於訓練的 CUDA-L1 競爭。一個針對科學計算中專門的模板運算子的案例研究進一步實現了相較於 cuDNN 的 \(1.53\times\) 加速，展示了該通用框架在標準機器學習工作負載之外的潛力。
